bayts.text: Praise be to Allah, the Answerer (Al-Mujīb), Possessor of the Decree, Who has singled us out, by grace, with the Night of Power (Laylat al-Qadr),
magnifying its rank in time, until it became better than a thousand months (Qurʾān 97:3).
Then blessing and peace, forever, upon him who appeared as the best of creation,
Muḥammad, the Family and the noble Companions, as long as the supplicant attains the most excellent aim.
That said: truly today I seek the rain (of favours) from the Generous, for all my wishes.
O our Lord, by the merit of this night, veil my faults and hear my words.
O our Lord, by the merit of this day, set right my affairs and the affairs of my people.
O our Lord, by its merit spare me all that harms me, and make right guidance a ladder for me.
O our Lord, by its blessing grant me the Gardens (al-jinān) and purify my heart (al-janān).
O our Lord, by its standing grant the two lights to me and to the community, in the two Abodes.
And lead us along the way of achievement and success, and draw our hearts to renunciation and righteousness.
And bestow on us a felicity that lasts, and grace, O You Whose kingdom lasts.
And bless with the best blessing and peace him among whose abodes is the Abode of Peace,
Muḥammad, the gate of guidance, repeller of ruin, far-reaching, dispeller of darkness since he came,
and the Family, the Companions and whoever has called on You, as long as the caller returns with the mighty triumph.
